question: Does handing a row another document's entire memory move the real-token loss of the audit's model (300 iters, unmasked, hinge off), with an instrument shown to read both ways?

commands.argv: uv run python experiments/shuffle-control/run.py --single --seed 0 --iters 300 --device cpu --out-dir runs/shuffle-control/seed0
uv run python experiments/shuffle-control/run.py --single --seed 1 --iters 300 --device cpu --out-dir runs/shuffle-control/seed1
uv run python experiments/shuffle-control/run.py --single --seed 2 --iters 300 --device cpu --out-dir runs/shuffle-control/seed2

verdict.falsifier: PREREG.md Amendment 1: any seed whose mean |token delta| is >= 0.1 of the live decoy's falsifies 'the memory is inert'; any failed control makes the run inconclusive
verdict.detail: every seed's mean |token delta| is <= 0.01 of the live decoy's ({0: 0.0009913241306859642, 1: 0.0008765567882922645, 2: 0.0004705000245672635}), and all three controls read as required on every seed
